title: 輸電距離保護
summary: 以視在阻抗、故障回路與動作區辨識串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect apparent impedance, fault loops and zone discrimination through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 回路與阻抗
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「回路與阻抗」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop loops and impedance through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 故障回路：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「故障回路」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for fault loops.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「故障回路」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。相間與接地故障使用不同電壓電流組合。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「逐回路寫出量測相量。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for fault loops, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Phase and ground faults use different V/I combinations. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Write measured phasors for each loop. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observationEn: Write measured phasors for each loop.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「故障回路」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping fault loops verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「故障回路」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「逐回路寫出量測相量。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for fault loops; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 相間與接地故障使用不同電壓電流組合。
knowledge.textEn: Phase and ground faults use different V/I combinations.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 逐回路寫出量測相量。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Write measured phasors for each loop. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 離線示例同一回路相量 V=20 kV∠30°、I=1 kA∠0°，Z=V/I=20∠30° Ω=17.32+j10 Ω。這是回路示意，接地故障需補償，不能直接作保護整定。
knowledge.textEn: For one offline loop V=20 kV∠30° and I=1 kA∠0°, Z=20∠30° Ω=17.32+j10 Ω. Ground faults need compensation; this is not a protection setting.

quiz.question: 審查「故障回路」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for fault loops?
options: 相間與接地故障使用不同電壓電流組合。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「故障回路」的驗證。
只調整「故障回路」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Phase and ground faults use different V/I combinations.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping fault loops verification.
Tuning the displayed fault loops result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 相間與接地故障使用不同電壓電流組合。 逐回路寫出量測相量。
quiz.explanationEn: Phase and ground faults use different V/I combinations. Write measured phasors for each loop.

steps.title: 故障回路：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「故障回路」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for fault loops.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。逐回路寫出量測相量。 比較差異是否符合「相間與接地故障使用不同電壓電流組合。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Write measured phasors for each loop. Compare the result against: Phase and ground faults use different V/I combinations. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observationEn: Write measured phasors for each loop.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「故障回路」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping fault loops verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「故障回路」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for fault loops; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
